sentences.text:
Author: Rakesh Thapliyal
Bench: Rakesh Thapliyal
Sl. Office Notes,
No. Date reports,
 orders or Court'S Or Judge'S Order

S  proceedings  or directions  and  Registrar's  order with  Signatures  C528 No. 259 of 2026  Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1.
Ms. Aishwarya Thapliyal, learned counsel holding the brief of Mr. Abhishek Verma, learned counsel for the applicant.
2. Mr. S.S. Chauhan, learned Dy. A.G. with Mr. Vikas Uniyal, learned Brief Holder for the State.

3. The present applicant is praying for expediting the proceedings of Criminal Case No. 13 of 2025,
arising out of FIR No. 0434 of 2023, State vs. Deshraj wherein respondent no. 2 Deshraj, the grand-father of the husband of the applicant is facing the trial for the offences punishable under sections 452, 498A, 504, 506 IPC read with Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
4.

It is argued by the learned counsel for the applicant that though the FIR was lodged against 14 persons including the husband, namely, Ajay Kamboj but in fact they all left the country and went Canada and never joined the investigation due to which charge sheet could not be filed against them.
5.

Admittedly, prima facie, from the contents of the FIR there was some matrimonial dispute in between the applicant and her husband Ajay Kamboj, and, now the grand-father of Ajay Kamboj is facing the trial.
Taking into consideration that the dispute is nothing but appears to be matrimonial dispute, then efforts may be made for their amicable settlement.
Steps to be taken within a week.

8. In addition to this, Mr. S.S. Chauhan, learned Dy. A.G. shall ensure service upon respondent no. 2 through S.H.O. concerned so that on the next date at least respondent no. 2, grand-father of Ajay Kamboj, may ensure his presence through V.C.
C528/259/2026 on 23 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/177582955/
1
10. Put up this matter on 24.03.2026 before appropriate Bench.

Parul C528/259/2026 on 23 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/177582955/
2
